privacy.title: Privacy Policy (GDPR)
privacy.e2eeText: GlassFolio is engineered from the ground up on an end-to-end encryption (E2EE) architecture. All sensitive financial records (transactions, holdings, average purchase prices, fiscal declarations, goals, and BYOK AI keys) are encrypted directly inside your browser memory using WebCrypto AES-256-GCM. Derivation uses PBKDF2-SHA256 with 600,000 iterations and HKDF-SHA256.
privacy.e2eeNoServer: Crucially, no financial records are ever exposed in plaintext. Your unencrypted financial data, master password, recovery key, and TOTP seeds are never transmitted in plaintext to any third party or remote server.
privacy.externalText: To provide live portfolio valuations and AI capabilities, your browser may establish direct client-side network connections to the following external endpoints:
privacy.externalYahoo: Yahoo Finance & CoinGecko: Direct HTTP requests from your browser for real-time asset market quotes and foreign exchange rates (cached locally with a 15-minute TTL).
privacy.externalAi: User-Configured AI Providers: If you configure a BYOK API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, OpenRouter), requests are sent directly from your browser to the chosen provider. Alternatively, you may select Local Ollama for 100% offline, zero-data-egress AI assistance.
privacy.externalCdn: Static Assets: Tailwind CSS is injected via cdn.tailwindcss.com and font styles from Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com). No user portfolio data is ever shared with these CDNs.
privacy.rightsText: Under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), you hold complete sovereignty over your data:
privacy.rightAccess: Right of Access & Portability (Art. 20): You can export your entire unencrypted ledger and portfolio as a standardized JSON backup at any time from Settings.
privacy.rightErasure: Right to Erasure (Art. 17): You can completely purge all stored keys and ciphertext instantly via the Settings 'Purge Vault' action.
privacy.rightComplaint: Right to lodge a complaint: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the French supervisory authority, the CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés — www.cnil.fr).

terms.title: Terms of Use (CGU) & Disclaimers
terms.disclaimerImportant: GlassFolio is strictly an informational software demonstration and mathematical simulation tool. It does NOT provide certified investment advice (Conseil en Investissements Financiers — CIF), portfolio management services, or legal tax counsel under French or European financial regulations.

cookies.title: Cookies & Local Storage Inventory
cookies.overviewText: GlassFolio does NOT use third-party tracking cookies or advertising pixels. All persistent client-side data is managed through the browser's local storage abstraction layer (appStorage) under strict cryptographic segmentation.

vaultHeader.purpose: Stores the PBKDF2 salt, auth verification tag, and passkey PRF metadata. Contains no financial values.

vaultPayload.purpose: AES-256-GCM encrypted financial ledger records (transactions, positions, goals, AI secrets). Only readable with your master key in RAM.

themeLang.purpose: Stores your chosen UI theme (Light, Dark, Midnight) and language preference (EN, FR) across sessions.

consent.purpose: Stores your CNIL GDPR analytics consent record and timestamp.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Declaration (RGAA 4.1)
accessibility.statusText: GlassFolio commits to making its interface accessible in accordance with Article 47 of French Law No. 2005-102 of February 11, 2005. The application is currently PARTIALLY COMPLIANT with the General Accessibility Improvement Framework (RGAA version 4.1 / WCAG 2.1 Level AA), as a formal external audit is pending.
accessibility.featAria: Semantic Landmarks & ARIA: Proper semantic tags (header, nav, main, section, footer), accessible button labels (aria-label on all icon-only controls), and accordion controls (aria-expanded, aria-controls).
accessibility.featContrast: WCAG AA Color Contrast: Strict SSOT semantic token system enforcing minimum 4.5:1 text-to-background contrast across Light, Dark, and Midnight themes.
accessibility.featKeyboard: Keyboard Navigation: Visible focus outlines and tab sequence across all interactive controls, modals, and drawers.
accessibility.featMotion: Reduced Motion: Respects the user's operating system prefers-reduced-motion preference, disabling decorative transitions and animations.
accessibility.feedbackText: If you encounter an accessibility defect or barrier on this application, please open an issue on the repository or contact Damien via https://github.com/Damien-Esilv.
